Q: How can I include only certain classes to apply jackson fail_on_unknown_properties with false? A:

Standard Spring Boot properties for Jackson are "all or nothing." The property jackson.deserialization.fail_on_unknown_properties translates to a global boolean flag on the ObjectMapper. There is no built-in syntax to provide a list of classes or packages within the YML for this specific setting.

If you want only farm.java and gym.java to ignore unknown properties while house.java and school.java still trigger errors:

  1. Global Config: Ensure FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES is enabled (which is the default Jackson behavior).

  2. Selective Config: Apply the @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown = true) annotation via a Mix-in to the specific classes.

Q: ssh-copy-id on windows doesn't work: No such file or directory A:

Use ssh-copy-id from msys2:

/usr/bin/ssh-copy-id -i /c/Users/WindowsUserName/.ssh/id_rsa.pub USERNAME@HOSTNAME

Then use ssh from Windows:

C:\Windows\System32\OpenSSH\ssh.exe USERNAME@HOSTNAME

Q: Why does order of defining hidden friend binary operator- vs operator==, and using int vs concepts matter to NVCC? A:

In TestPointerLike4, the compiler may fail to resolve operator== because the hidden operator- declaration interferes with ADL or overload resolution when std::nullopt_t is involved. NVCC may not consider the operator== overload as viable if the operator- is defined in a way that confuses the lookup order or template deduction.

Try to replace std::nullopt_t with std::nullptr_t or a plain int temporarily to isolate the issue.
